name: ContentCore
summary: Web tool for creating share-ready images and videos in one place from free tools and assets.
description: An online content studio: free tools and assets for making share-ready images and videos without extra software or a steep learning curve. The free Basic plan includes a non-commercial license on created content; $9.99/month unlocks commercial use, and Enterprise & Business plans build tailored content generation tools for static assets, videos, web sections and web pages.
contains: create content in one place and export as images or videos
free Basic plan with non-commercial license on created content
